summary: Accepted: the final WI #2774 contract has no known-failure exemption and passes its native black-box verifier against the real public `aw ec check` boundary. It pins a baseline digest; introduces non-UTF-8 pyc/native-extension plus build-directory Python, text, and extensionless artifacts; requires the post-artifact digest to remain identical; proves every ignored artifact remains byte-identical; and retains strict missing-source and declared-binary failures. The DeveloperTool capability's required efficiency and stability dimensions remain covered by separate operational cases.
